text: Cycling is a sport that combines physical exercise, mental focus, and adventure. It's a way to enjoy the outdoors while being active and healthy. When cycling, it's essential to wear a helmet to protect your head in case of an accident. Gears are also crucial for riding efficiently and smoothly. Adjusting the gears can help you reach your desired speed and climb steep inclines. Additionally, understanding how gears work can help you avoid fatigue and maintain a comfortable ride. Lastly, wearing protective gear like gloves and boots is vital to prevent injuries and ensure safety on the road.
